Class Dialog

java.lang.Object
io.mcs.taskmanager.ui.Dialog
Direct Known Subclasses:
DeleteTaskDialog, TaskDialog
public abstract class Dialog extends Object
A dialog over the window: its title and note, its fields, and what its buttons do. A save the service refuses leaves the dialog open with the service's words under the fields, unless the task it was opened on has gone, deleted in another copy of the app: then it closes, and the window says so over the list. A save the service takes closes it, and the window shows what was saved.
Author:
Hamza Rasool, Abdullah Khan
